name: Performance Foodservice - Dallas Fort Worth (Fort Worth TX)

fieldNotes._locationNote: Roster coords (32.767167,-97.265073, ROOFTOP, 58 m moved) are correct, but Google's overhead satellite imagery of this exact spot still shows graded greenfield — it predates the building. Street View from John Hancock-equivalent road at this point, captured Jan 2025, shows a large white industrial building under final construction directly behind a stone-faced retaining wall, with an office/admin front elevation and a dock-area wing. This is the new PFG / Scannell cold-storage DC. Overhead yard-detail imagery is unavailable.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Medium-confidence true. This is a brand-new, build-to-suit cold-storage food DC (developer Scannell Properties / GC ARCO National; TDLR project 'Scannell - PFG Dallas', completion June 2025). New build-to-suit food DCs of this class are essentially always built with a controlled, fenced truck entrance. The Jan-2025 Street View shows a partly-built perimeter wall and a defined site entry, but the gate hardware itself is not yet resolvable. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth confirmed. Modern new-build food DCs typically use a kiosk / camera / app check-in rather than a staffed booth; no booth structure was visible in the construction-phase Street View. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Medium-confidence true — assumes a controlled gate with kiosk/app check-in and no staffed guard shack, the standard pattern for a 2025-vintage cold-storage DC. Flagged uncertain; depends on truckGate being true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. The facility is a 343,000-355,000 sq ft cold-storage DC (per TDLR / ARCO / Scannell). A DC of this size and class typically carries 50+ dock doors. Exact count not verifiable from available imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NONE recorded because no trailers were visible (building was still under construction in the imagery). The completed facility will have a truck court / trailer parking, but it could not be measured. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Not confirmed — yard not yet built out in available imagery. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: A facility of this size will have a deep interior truck court; recorded true on that basis but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Far east Fort Worth on a greenfield industrial site surrounded by graded land, oilfield-services pads, and an emerging industrial corridor; sparse surrounding development. Classified Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large cold-storage distribution building (343,000-355,000 sq ft).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur — none visible in imagery and not mentioned in project documentation.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale confirmed; not verifiable from available imagery.
